E-Invoice Validator

UBL 2.1 XSD, EN 16931 / French EXTENDED-CTC-FR and BR-FR rules for UBL invoices and credit notes, BR-FR-CDV for CDAR life-cycle messages, and Flux 10 e-reporting (XSD + rules). Validation runs inside your browser — files are never uploaded anywhere.

About, rule versions and licences

Build: 17.11.2026.

EN 16931 rules: CEN/TC 434 validation artefacts 1.3.17 (ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931, EUPL 1.2) — the same rule set as the European Commission eInvoice Validator.
French rules: FNFE-MPE France_RFE 1.4.0.04 (EXTENDED-CTC-FR-UBL, BR-FR-Flux2-Schematron-UBL, BR-FR-CDV-Schematron-CDAR, UBL 2.1 XSD), Apache License 2.0. The EXTENDED-CTC-FR rules are used when the CustomizationID is the French extended profile, otherwise the EN 16931 rules.
Flux 10 e-reporting: FNFE-MPE France_RFE 1.4.0.04 Flux10 schematron (PPF Annexe 7 v1.8) and XSD, Apache License 2.0.
XSD engine: xmllint-wasm (libxml2), MIT licence.
XSLT engine: SaxonJS 2.7, Copyright © Saxonica Ltd. Redistributed unmodified in binary form under the Saxonica SaxonJS licence.
